predecessor_note: First release of this project. The delta below is the whole reachable history, a6f370d to the release commit.
module_rules: A module owns one coherent subsystem, object, procedure family, or its private data.
A procedure and its private tables are not split merely to satisfy a line target.
ROM order is preserved by include order even when one logical subsystem has several non-contiguous modules.
Mixed address buckets and filenames derived from ROM addresses are not release-quality modules.
A module over 1000 lines requires a named concrete-boss waiver with a documented cohesion argument.
naming_rules: An address is never a symbol identity.
A semantic name must be supported by static, runtime, or authoritative format evidence.
An uncertain symbol receives an honest role-neutral name and an unknowns-register entry, not an invented behavior.
Every imported or replaced name retains traceable provenance.

delta.summary: The single imported translation unit became src/main.s, an index of 379 address-ordered modules under a 1000-line ceiling, with config/rom_layout.json owning every module range, the landmarks and the padding.
make verify builds from source and compares byte by byte against the cartridge dump, reproducing SHA-1 8f6eb584ed9487b8504fbc21d86783f58e6c9cd6.

Every address-derived identifier was replaced and the result audited module by module: 15,831 exact-address records, each with the previous name, the imported name and the static evidence behind the current one.

The naming convention became enforceable: 192 declared subsystems, a derivation rule and two hardware exception sets, checked by make lint. Turning it on found sixteen definitions never brought over from the disassembly.

1,293 work RAM fields, the hardware ports and the shared equates were named in include files and documented, the symbol export checks them against the build, and no work RAM address is reached through a raw literal.
Twelve scenarios replay three pinned movies under the pinned emulator and check 78 named work RAM expectations resolved through src/ram_addrs.inc.
579 data segments are extracted from the user-supplied image by a recorded recipe, hash-pinned in assets/manifest.json and never tracked.
This manifest replaced a shape-only configuration file: scope, delta, requirements with evidence, layout deviations, licensing and provenance are now declared and machine-checkable.

canonical_identity.statement: The build reproduces the Japanese cartridge image byte for byte, compared byte by byte and not by hash alone.

reproducible_build.statement: The gate cleans every reproducible output before building, so no result depends on a previous build.

source_boundary.statement: All executable 68000 code is assembly source in 379 address-ordered modules. The Z80 sound driver program remains a verbatim payload.

naming_vocabulary.statement: Every definition is owned by one of 192 declared subsystems, derives from a symbol that exists, or is a declared hardware exception, and make lint rejects anything else.

provenance_and_unknowns.statement: No live definition is address-derived, every replaced name keeps a traceable marker, and every provenance-mapped current name has an exact-address record with static evidence.

memory_map.statement: Work RAM, hardware ports and shared equates are named in include files and documented field by field. No work RAM address is formed from a raw $FFFFxxxx literal: make lint rejects one in any address-forming instruction, with a ceiling of zero.

baseline_documentation.statement: The documentation set states the current confirmed position, is indexed, and is checked against this manifest by the release audit.

baseline_validation.statement: Style, source policy, project policy and the Python tools are all checked by commands the release interface names.

release_contract.statement: This manifest declares the release line, kind, scope, delta and gates, and the audit resolves each requirement to evidence that exists.

private_inputs.statement: The cartridge image and every byte extracted from it are supplied by the user and are not tracked anywhere in the reachable history.

generated_outputs.statement: build/, the extracted data tree and the runtime captures are reproducible and removable, and make clean preserves user-supplied evidence.

claims_need_evidence.statement: Semantic names are recorded with their evidence level, and an unresolved symbol takes a role-neutral name and an unknowns entry rather than an invented behaviour.

toolchain_reproducibility.statement: The assembler, converter and emulator are vendored and pinned by size and SHA-256. Only the Windows host has run the gate.

runtime_coverage.statement: Twelve replayed scenarios check named work RAM across boot, the title screen, the options screen, the story screen, weapon setup, gameplay, a boss transition, a stage change, an inter-stage transition, attract-mode demo playback and the credits. Coverage is state, not pixels.

licensing_and_provenance.statement: The legal status of the game data, the vendored tools and the recorded movies is stated, and none of the game data is tracked.

tag_integrity.statement: The annotated tag source-reconstruction-1.0 exists on the commit that make release-check passed in full, and it carries the release description.

commit_history.statement: No non-merge commit has a tree equal to its parent. Commits before this manifest carry a title and attribution without the body the contract asks for; the history is not rewritten, and commits from here on carry it.

excluded_scope.reason: Only the Japanese cartridge is accepted. A region variant would need its own identity, extraction and runtime evidence, none of which exists.
excluded_scope.control: config/release_0_5.json names the profile as excluded and make verify accepts the Japanese image alone.

excluded_scope.reason: The Z80 driver program is copied verbatim and never disassembled. It is executable code inside a binary asset, which the source boundary rule otherwise forbids, so the exclusion is named here rather than left implicit.
excluded_scope.control: Sound_Z80DriverProgram owns the payload in src/sound/z80_program.s, its range is declared in config/rom_layout.json, and its bytes are hash-pinned in assets/manifest.json.

excluded_scope.reason: Five hundred and thirteen _End labels immediately follow their own binclude payload and carry no separate semantic claim, so they hold no exact-address record of their own.
excluded_scope.control: make semantic-audit classifies them, and reports zero other pending end labels and zero modules remaining, so nothing else hides behind the classification.

excluded_scope.reason: The preferred module size is 200 to 700 lines. 204 of 379 modules are inside it, 145 are shorter and 30 are longer, because the module rule forbids splitting a procedure from its private tables merely to reach a line count.
excluded_scope.control: The 1000-line ceiling is a hard limit that make lint enforces and no module reaches it, and config/rom_layout.json declares every module range.

excluded_scope.reason: Two hundred and seven imported cross-reference comments across 95 modules still quote address-derived names that no longer define anything. They are comment text, not identifiers.
excluded_scope.control: No live definition is address-derived, which make lint enforces with a ceiling of zero, so the stale text cannot be mistaken for a symbol that resolves.

excluded_scope.reason: analyze, debug-pointers, find-unanalyzed, prepare-batch and rename predate the split into address-ordered modules and mutate a single translation unit.
excluded_scope.control: They are outside the release interface in config/release_0_5.json, and docs/tooling_status.md states that their output is not evidence.

excluded_scope.reason: The runtime layer checks work RAM, not pixels. Screenshot comparison needs a reference capture from a known-good build, and none is tracked.
excluded_scope.control: The runtime scenarios declare named RAM expectations instead, and each is resolved through src/ram_addrs.inc.

excluded_scope.reason: bin/linux_x86_64 is vendored and the Makefile autodetects it, but the gate has not been run on a Linux host, and make trace additionally needs a Windows emulator binary.
excluded_scope.control: config/toolchain.json records the Linux host as partial rather than supported.

excluded_scope.reason: Alien Soldier on the Mega Drive has one canonical Japanese image in scope. There are no additional revisions or platform profiles to accept.
Editors and content tools belong to a later release. 1.0 ships extraction and verification only.
Commits made before this manifest carry a title and an attribution trailer without the two or three explanatory paragraphs the workflow asks for. Published history is not rewritten.
excluded_scope.control: CONTRIBUTING.md states the convention, and commits from this manifest onward carry it.

artifacts.note: Regenerated by the gate and never committed; it is byte-identical to the cartridge dump, so tracking it would track the game.

layout_deviations.reason: There is no linker: AS emits one object and p2bin flattens it, so there is no linker script to own the layout.
layout_deviations.equivalent_control: config/rom_layout.json declares the memory regions, the ROM landmarks, the padding gap and all 379 module ranges, and make verify-layout checks every one against the build.

layout_deviations.reason: The runtime inputs are one declarative file rather than a directory, and the recorded movies they replay live in movies/ beside their own README.
layout_deviations.equivalent_control: make runtime replays every declared scenario and validates its named RAM expectations, and tests/test_runtime_contract.py checks the declaration itself.

layout_deviations.actual_path: scripts/*.py, invoked directly from the Makefile
layout_deviations.reason: Thirty-eight flat modules with distinct names; subpackaging them would add import machinery without making ownership clearer at this size.
layout_deviations.equivalent_control: Every script is named for its role, the Makefile is the single public interface, and release_audit.py checks that each command this manifest names exists as a target.

layout_deviations.reason: The AS Macro Assembler convention in this project is .s for assembly sources.
layout_deviations.equivalent_control: config/source_policy.json declares the entrypoint path and make lint checks that it emits no bytes and that its include order matches config/rom_layout.json.

layout_deviations.rule_id: assets/ holds only manifests, hashes and extraction recipes
layout_deviations.reason: The extraction recipe is a separate address table consumed by scripts/split_data_from_rom.py, and the 579 extracted segments are generated into data/ and never tracked.
layout_deviations.equivalent_control: make check-assets verifies every segment against assets/manifest.json, and tests/test_clean_policy.py checks that the generated tree is removable and untracked.

layout_deviations.rule_id: bin/ is not part of the recommended layout
layout_deviations.reason: The assembler and converter are vendored per platform so the build is reproducible without a host toolchain install.
layout_deviations.equivalent_control: config/toolchain.json pins every vendored file by size and SHA-256 and make verify-toolchain checks them.

layout_deviations.reason: The corpus is flat and the documents are named for what this project calls them rather than for the generic titles.
layout_deviations.equivalent_control: docs/index.md maps every document to the question it answers, and config/release_0_5.json lists the required documents that make release-audit checks.

licensing.note: The cartridge image and every byte extracted from it are supplied by the user and never tracked. The repository holds the reconstruction, not the game.
AS Macro Assembler and p2bin are redistributed under their own terms; bin/README.md records the upstream and the versions.
The replay inputs in movies/ are recordings made for this project and carry no ROM payload.

private_dependencies.role: Byte-identity reference and the source of every extracted data segment
